author: Tsar_Illya
body:
On the first of November 2014, I was ban from the avicus server on minecraft. What had happened (which was me flying) wasn't my fault as on the day I had very bad connection and as I stepped on the block that flings you up (in the lobby) I was sprung right into a golden block which was displaying the nebula game. As I was stuck in the air the server ban me. I regret being ban and I haven't been given a chance to be able to be unban. I believe waiting nearly a whole year had been enough please accept my apology and unban me, sincerely Maxpower199.

P.S I was ban by RCMP_Mountie and I ask for you to consider what I wrote and unban me please.
